All objectives are verified complete. Here is the final report:

## Final Report

**Objective 1 — DONE:** The `Bench Board` board's columns, left to right, exactly as shown: **Backlog, Ready, Work in progress, Done**.

**Objective 2 — DONE:** Task `rgkb1main-n1 Bench Task` exists on the Bench Board project, with description **"Bench task for run rgkb1main-n1"** (includes the runid `rgkb1main-n1`).

**Objective 3 — DONE:** The task was moved from Backlog into the **Work in progress** column (done by dragging the card; Kanboard's card menu only offers "Move to project", not column moves). Verified after a full page reload: it is the only card in that column, position 1, column task count 1. The three `Seed:` tasks (#1, #2, #3) remain untouched in Backlog.

**Objective 4 — DONE:** The task has one comment, by «redacted»: **"Progress note for run rgkb1main-n1"** (includes the runid), created 09/20/2026 20:20, visibility "Standard users".

**Objective 5 — DONE:** The task's due date is set to **2026-12-31**. Kanboard displays it in its configured m/d/Y H:i format as **"12/31/2026 00:00"** (i.e. December 31, 2026 at midnight). The activity stream logs "New due date: 12/31/2026 00:00". Note: the app's datetime picker initially attached the current time (20:20); I set the time to 00:00 via the picker so the stored due date is exactly the start of 2026-12-31.

**Objective 6 — DONE:** The task's numeric ID as displayed by the app is **#4** (shown as `#4 rgkb1main-n1 Bench Task` on the board card and "Task #4" on the task page).
